mainTopic: Does the קרבן פסח and its preparation override שבת? The end of the מחלוקת between רבי אליעזר and רבי עקיבא, הלל's proofs to the בני בתירא, and the גמרא's analysis of those proofs.
overview: This amud first finishes the משנה's debate between רבי אליעזר and רבי עקיבא. רבי עקיבא flips רבי אליעזר's קל וחומר and shows that the verse ״במועדו״ covers only the slaughter of the פסח. He concludes with a rule: anything that could have been done before שבת does not override שבת. The גמרא then brings a ברייתא about the time the בני בתירא forgot whether the פסח overrides שבת at all. הלל הבבלי proves that it does, with a גזירה שוה of ״מועדו״ from the תמיד and with a קל וחומר. He is made נשיא and rebukes them for not serving שמעיה ואבטליון. When he forgets what to do about a knife left behind before שבת, the people's practice of placing it in the animal's wool or between its horns reminds him of the הלכה. The גמרא then analyzes הלל's proofs. It finds that the תמיד's own source is ״עולת שבת בשבתו״. The קל וחומר is refutable, because the תמיד is תדיר and כליל, so הלל said it only as a rebuke. Finally the גמרא quotes the line about the knife in order to discuss it next.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא flips the argument around
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא reverses רבי אליעזר's קל וחומר. If הזאה, which is only a שבות, does not override שבת, then slaughter, which is a full מלאכה, should not override שבת either.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי עקיבא said to him: Or flip it around. If הזאה, which is forbidden only as a שבות, does not push aside שבת, then שחיטה, which is a real מלאכה forbidden by the תורה, should surely not push aside שבת!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי עקיבא takes the same kind of logic רבי אליעזר used and runs it in the opposite direction. This leads to a shocking result: even the slaughter of the פסח would not override שבת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אליעזר had built his argument starting from שחיטה, which we know overrides שבת. רבי עקיבא starts instead from הזאה, which we know does not override שבת. That gives a mirror-image קל וחומר pointing the other way. His goal is to show that a קל וחומר alone cannot settle this question.

keyTerms.meaning: Or reverse it: flipping the direction of an argument
Sprinkling the purifying water of the פרה אדומה on someone who is טמא מת
An act forbidden on שבת only by rabbinic law
A labor forbidden on שבת by the Torah
Is it not logical? This is the formula of a קל וחומר

steps.confusionAlert: רבי עקיבא does not really hold that the פסח may not be slaughtered on שבת. He is showing that the קל וחומר method can be turned around, so it cannot be the deciding proof.

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא, אוֹ חִלּוּף:
phrases.english: Rabbi Akiva said to him: Or reverse it:

phrases.aramaic: מָה אִם הַזָּאָה שֶׁהִיא מִשּׁוּם שְׁבוּת —
phrases.english: If sprinkling, which is forbidden only as a rabbinic rest-rule,
does not override Shabbos,
then slaughter, which is forbidden as a Torah labor,

phrases.aramaic: אֵינוֹ דִּין שֶׁלֹּא תִּדְחֶה אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת?!
phrases.english: is it not logical that it should not override Shabbos?!

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא, אוֹ חִלּוּף
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Responds to רבי אליעזר's earlier קל וחומר from שחיטה, which appears earlier in the משנה on the previous amud.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי אליעזר's קל וחומר that the preparations for the פסח override שבת.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The same type of reasoning, starting from הזאה, leads to the opposite result. So the argument proves nothing.

steps.title: רבי אליעזר answers with the verse במועדו
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר rejects the reversed argument because the Torah explicitly says ״במועדו״. That word means the פסח is brought on its set day, whether it falls on a weekday or on שבת.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אליעזר said to him: עקיבא, you have uprooted what is written in the תורה, ״במועדו״ (in its appointed time), which means both on a weekday and on שבת.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי אליעזר says that רבי עקיבא's flipped argument contradicts a clear verse. A קל וחומר cannot cancel what the Torah states outright.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Slaughtering the פסח on שבת is directly taught by the word ״במועדו״. So any logic concluding that slaughter does not override שבת must be wrong. רבי אליעזר thinks this also brings back his own argument.

keyTerms.meaning: You have uprooted, meaning you contradicted the Torah
Whether on a weekday or on שבת

phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer said to him: Akiva,
you have uprooted what is written in the Torah:
״in its appointed time,″ whether on a weekday or on Shabbos.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לוֹ רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר: עֲקִיבָא, עָקַרְתָּ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּתּוֹרָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects רבי עקיבא's reversed קל וחומר.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The conclusion of the reversed argument, namely that slaughter would not override שבת.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא: the verse covers only the slaughter
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא replies that ״במועדו״ gives a fixed time only for the slaughter. There is no fixed time for the preparations, such as carrying the animal.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: My teacher, show me a fixed time for these preparations like the fixed time for the slaughter.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי עקיבא agrees that slaughter overrides שבת because of the verse. He points out, though, that the verse says nothing about the preparations.
steps.deeperAnalysis: His real point now becomes clear. The verse protects slaughter, so his reversed argument cannot apply to slaughter. But the preparations have no verse, so his argument from הזאה does apply to them. That means the preparations do not override שבת.

keyTerms.meaning: Bring me, show me a source
A fixed time for these, meaning the preparations

phrases.english: He said to him: My teacher,
bring me a fixed time for these,
like the fixed time for the slaughter.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לוֹ: רַבִּי, הָבֵא לִי מוֹעֵד לְאֵלּוּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רבי אליעזר's objection by narrowing what the verse covers.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limiting the scope of the verse
steps.terutzHavaAmina: That ״במועדו״ makes everything connected to the פסח override שבת.
steps.terutzMaskana: ״במועדו״ covers only the slaughter, which has a fixed time. The preparations have no fixed time, so they remain under the reversed argument and do not override שבת.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא's general rule
steps.stepSummary: Any labor that could be done before שבת does not override שבת. Slaughter, which cannot be done before שבת, does override it.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי עקיבא stated a general rule: any מלאכה that can be done on ערב שבת does not push aside שבת. שחיטה, which cannot be done on ערב שבת, does push aside שבת.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי עקיבא sums up his position as one clear rule that decides the whole debate.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The test is whether the act could have been done before שבת. Carrying the animal or bringing it from outside the תחום can be done on ערב שבת. The slaughter must happen on the 14th itself.

keyTerms.meaning: It can be done on ערב שבת

steps.whatToRemember: רבי עקיבא's rule: only what could not have been done before שבת overrides שבת. Slaughter overrides it; the preparations do not.
steps.whyThisMatters: This rule of רבי עקיבא is the accepted הלכה. The same idea, that preparations which could be done earlier do not override שבת, appears in other places too, such as מילה.

phrases.english: Rabbi Akiva stated a general rule:

phrases.aramaic: כׇּל מְלָאכָה שֶׁאֶפְשָׁר לַעֲשׂוֹתָהּ מֵעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת —
phrases.english: Any labor that can be done on the eve of Shabbos
does not override Shabbos.

phrases.aramaic: שְׁחִיטָה, שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לַעֲשׂוֹתָהּ מֵעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת —
phrases.english: Slaughter, which cannot be done on the eve of Shabbos,
overrides Shabbos.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Turns רבי עקיבא's answer into a general principle.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: Labor that could have been done before שבת does not override שבת. Only the unavoidable slaughter on its day does.

steps.title: The בני בתירא forget the law
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא tells that the 14th of ניסן once fell on שבת. The בני בתירא forgot whether the פסח overrides שבת, and they asked if anyone knew.
steps.simpleTranslation: The רבנן taught: this law was forgotten by the בני בתירא. Once the 14th fell on שבת, and they forgot and did not know whether the פסח overrides שבת or not. They said: Is there anyone who knows whether the פסח overrides שבת or not?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins with a story. It sets up the problem: the leaders forgot the basic law and are searching for someone who knows it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה argued only about the preparations, because everyone agrees the slaughter itself overrides שבת. This ברייתא goes back to that basic point and shows how it was once forgotten and then restored.

keyTerms.meaning: The Beteira family, the leaders of that generation

phrases.english: GEMARA: The Rabbis taught:
This law was forgotten by the Bnei Beteira.

phrases.aramaic: פַּעַם אַחַת חָל אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר לִהְיוֹת בְּשַׁבָּת,
phrases.english: Once the fourteenth fell on Shabbos,
they forgot and did not know

phrases.aramaic: אִם פֶּסַח דּוֹחֶה אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת אִם לָאו.
phrases.english: whether the Pesach overrides Shabbos or not.
They said: Is there any person who knows

phrases.aramaic: אִם פֶּסַח דּוֹחֶה אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת אִם לָאו?
phrases.english: whether the Pesach overrides Shabbos or not?

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: הֲלָכָה זוֹ נִתְעַלְּמָה מִבְּנֵי בְתִירָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא with a ברייתא about the basic law that the slaughter of the פסח overrides שבת.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The law that the פסח overrides שבת was once forgotten and needed to be restored.

steps.title: They are told about הלל
steps.stepSummary: People tell them about הלל הבבלי. He studied under שמעיה ואבטליון, so he would know the law.
steps.simpleTranslation: They said to them: There is one man who came up from בבל, named הלל הבבלי, who served the two great men of the generation, שמעיה ואבטליון, and he knows whether the פסח overrides שבת or not.
steps.whatsHappening: Someone answers the בני בתירא's question by pointing them to הלל.
steps.deeperAnalysis: What makes הלל qualified is that he served the leading teachers of the generation. That means he has the tradition from them.

keyTerms.meaning: Served, meaning he studied as a close disciple
The leading pair of sages before הלל

phrases.english: They said to them: There is one man
who came up from Babylonia, and Hillel the Babylonian is his name,
who served the two great men of the generation,
Shemaya and Avtalyon,

phrases.aramaic: וְיוֹדֵעַ אִם פֶּסַח דּוֹחֶה אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת אִם לָאו.
phrases.english: and he knows whether the Pesach overrides Shabbos or not.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of whether anyone knows the law.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: הלל הבבלי, a student of שמעיה ואבטליון, knows the law.

steps.title: They call הלל and ask him
steps.stepSummary: The בני בתירא summon הלל and ask him whether the פסח overrides שבת.
steps.simpleTranslation: They sent and called for him. They said to him: Do you know whether the פסח overrides שבת or not?
steps.whatsHappening: The question is now put directly to הלל. This sets up his answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Nothing new about the law is added here. The step simply brings the question to the one person who can answer it.

keyTerms.meaning: They sent for him and called him

phrases.english: They sent and called for him,
they said to him: Do you know at all

phrases.aramaic: אִם הַפֶּסַח דּוֹחֶה אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת אִם לָאו?
phrases.english: whether the Pesach overrides Shabbos or not?

steps.triggerLanguage: שָׁלְחוּ וְקָרְאוּ לוֹ, אָמְרוּ לוֹ: כְּלוּם אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Acts on the advice to ask הלל.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Does the קרבן פסח override שבת?

steps.title: הלל: over two hundred offerings override שבת
steps.stepSummary: הלל answers that many more than 200 קרבנות a year override שבת, so the פסח is not unusual.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to them: Do we have only one פסח a year that overrides שבת? Don't we have many more than two hundred פסחים a year that override שבת?
steps.whatsHappening: הלל answers yes, the פסח overrides שבת. He points out that many other offerings already override שבת every year.
steps.deeperAnalysis: By ״פסחים״ הלל means communal offerings in general. Every שבת there are two תמידים plus two מוסף lambs, which is four a week. Over about 52 weeks that comes to more than 200 offerings brought on שבת. If all of those override שבת, the פסח should too.

keyTerms.meaning: And is it so that...? Introduces a rhetorical question
But is it not so that...

steps.confusionAlert: The ״200 פסחים″ are not 200 קרבנות פסח. הלל is using the word loosely for the תמיד and מוסף offerings brought on שבתות throughout the year.

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר לָהֶם: וְכִי פֶּסַח אֶחָד יֵשׁ לָנוּ בַּשָּׁנָה
phrases.english: He said to them: Do we have only one Pesach a year
that overrides Shabbos?
Do we not have many more than two hundred Pesach-offerings

phrases.aramaic: יֵשׁ לָנוּ בַּשָּׁנָה שֶׁדּוֹחִין אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת.
phrases.english: a year that override Shabbos?

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לָהֶם: וְכִי פֶּסַח אֶחָד יֵשׁ לָנוּ בַּשָּׁנָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question put to הלל.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Yes. Like the 200+ communal offerings brought on שבתות, the פסח overrides שבת.

steps.title: They ask הלל for his source
steps.stepSummary: The בני בתירא ask הלל how he knows this.
steps.simpleTranslation: They said to him: From where do you know this?
steps.whatsHappening: This is a setup line. They ask for the source, which prepares for הלל's proof in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Knowing that the תמיד overrides שבת does not automatically prove the same for the פסח. They want a clear link that connects the two.

keyTerms.meaning: From where do you know this?

phrases.english: They said to him: From where do you know this?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the basis of הלל's answer.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The Torah source connecting the פסח to the offerings that override שבת.

steps.title: הלל's proof from the word מועדו
steps.stepSummary: The word ״מועדו״ appears both for the פסח and for the תמיד. Just as the תמיד overrides שבת, so does the פסח.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to them: ״מועדו״ (its appointed time) is said about the פסח, and ״מועדו״ is said about the תמיד. Just as ״מועדו״ said about the תמיד overrides שבת, so too ״מועדו״ said about the פסח overrides שבת.
steps.whatsHappening: הלל proves his answer with a גזירה שוה: the same word in two places links their laws together.
steps.deeperAnalysis: We already know the תמיד overrides שבת, since the Torah commands it every day, including on שבת. The shared word ״מועדו״ carries that same law over to the פסח.

keyTerms.meaning: A teaching from an identical word that appears in two places
Just as ... so too; the comparison formula

steps.whatToRemember: הלל proved through the גזירה שוה of ״מועדו״, linking the פסח to the תמיד, that the פסח overrides שבת.
steps.whyThisMatters: This is the basic source that the slaughter of the פסח overrides שבת. Both רבי אליעזר and רבי עקיבא in the משנה accept it.

phrases.english: He said to them: ״Its appointed time″ is said regarding the Pesach,
and ״its appointed time″ is said regarding the Tamid:
just as ״its appointed time″ stated regarding the Tamid
overrides Shabbos,
so too ״its appointed time″ stated regarding the Pesach
overrides Shabbos.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לָהֶם: נֶאֱמַר ״מוֹעֲדוֹ״ בַּפֶּסַח, וְנֶאֱמַר ״מוֹעֲדוֹ״ בַּתָּמִיד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supplies the source that was asked for.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The גזירה שוה of ״מועדו״ (במדבר ט:ב and במדבר כח:ב) linking the פסח to the תמיד.

steps.title: A logical proof from the daily offering
steps.stepSummary: הלל adds a קל וחומר: the תמיד carries no כרת and still overrides שבת, so the פסח, which does carry כרת, should override שבת too.
steps.simpleTranslation: And also, it is a קל וחומר: if the תמיד, which carries no punishment of כרת, overrides שבת, then the פסח, which does carry כרת, surely should override שבת.
steps.whatsHappening: הלל gives a second proof, this time a logical one, that the פסח overrides שבת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If someone skips the תמיד, he is not punished with כרת. If someone skips the פסח, he is punished with כרת. So the פסח is the more serious מצוה. If the less serious offering overrides שבת, the more serious one should override it as well.

keyTerms.meaning: A logical argument from a lighter case to a stricter case

steps.whyThisMatters: Keep this proof in mind. Later the גמרא shows it can be refuted (step 22), says הלל actually said it first and it was rejected (step 23), and explains that he said it as a rebuke rather than as a real proof (step 25).

phrases.english: And furthermore, it is an a fortiori argument:
If the daily offering, which is not punishable by karet,
overrides Shabbat,
the Paschal lamb, which is punishable by karet,
is it not logical that it overrides Shabbat?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a second, logical proof to the גזירה שוה of step 10
steps.raayaSupportSource: קל וחומר from the תמיד, which overrides שבת even though it carries no כרת

steps.title: הלל is appointed נשיא
steps.stepSummary: Convinced by his proofs, the בני בתירא seat הלל at the head and appoint him נשיא, and he teaches הלכות פסח all day.
steps.simpleTranslation: Right away they seated him at the head, appointed him נשיא over them, and he taught the laws of פסח the whole day.
steps.whatsHappening: The story reports the result of הלל's proofs. They accept his answer and make him their leader.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question about פסח on שבת is now settled. By handing him the נשיאות, the בני בתירא show that הלל's knowledge is greater than theirs.

keyTerms.meaning: They seated him at the head
Head of the סנהדרין / communal leader

phrases.english: Immediately they seated him at the head,
and appointed him Nasi over them,
and he was expounding that entire day
the laws of Passover.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: The outcome of הלל's proofs
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: הלל's ruling is accepted, and he becomes נשיא.

steps.title: הלל rebukes them for not learning from their teachers
steps.stepSummary: הלל scolds the בני בתירא. He says their laziness in not serving שמעיה ואבטליון is why a man from Babylonia had to become their נשיא.
steps.simpleTranslation: He began to needle them with words. He said: What caused me to come up from Babylonia and become נשיא over you? It was your laziness, because you did not serve the two greatest scholars of the generation, שמעיה ואבטליון.
steps.whatsHappening: Now that he is נשיא, הלל criticizes the בני בתירא for not learning from the great teachers who lived among them.
steps.deeperAnalysis: שמעיה ואבטליון were right there in ארץ ישראל, yet the local leaders did not study under them. הלל traveled from far away and did learn from them. The story uses this to praise שימוש תלמידי חכמים, and it also prepares the next scene, where הלל himself forgets a הלכה.

keyTerms.meaning: You served (attended and learned from) a teacher
The great scholars of the generation

phrases.english: He began rebuking them with words.
He said to them: What caused it for you
that I should come up from Babylonia
and be Nasi over you?
The laziness that was in you,
that you did not serve the two greatest scholars of the generation,
Shemaya and Avtalyon.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the appointment to הלל's rebuke, which sets up the next episode
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Their failure to serve שמעיה ואבטליון is what caused הלל to become נשיא over them.

steps.title: What if someone forgot to bring the knife before שבת?
steps.stepSummary: The בני בתירא ask הלל what to do if a person forgot to bring his slaughtering knife before שבת.
steps.simpleTranslation: They said to him: רבי, if someone forgot and did not bring a knife before שבת, what is the law?
steps.whatsHappening: Right after the rebuke, a new practical question comes up: how can the knife reach the עזרה on שבת?
steps.deeperAnalysis: We already know the שחיטה of the פסח overrides שבת. But carrying the knife is only a preparation, and it could have been done before שבת. So carrying it on שבת is not permitted, and the question is how the person can still bring his קרבן.
steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix this up with the first question. Everyone already agrees the פסח overrides שבת. The new problem is only the preparation, bringing the knife, which could have been done before שבת.

phrases.english: They said to him: Our teacher,
if one forgot and did not bring a knife
from the eve of Shabbat, what is the law?

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמְרוּ לוֹ: רַבִּי, שָׁכַח וְלֹא הֵבִיא סַכִּין מֵעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת, מַהוּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new practical question put to the newly appointed נשיא
steps.sheelahInformationSought: How to bring the knife for שחיטת הפסח when it was not brought before שבת

steps.title: הלל forgot, so he says to trust the Jewish people
steps.stepSummary: הלל admits he learned this הלכה but forgot it. He says to leave it to the Jewish people, who are בני נביאים.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to them: I heard this הלכה and forgot it. But leave it to the Jewish people. If they are not prophets, they are the children of prophets.
steps.whatsHappening: הלל answers honestly that he forgot the הלכה. Instead of a ruling, he says the people will know what to do.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Right after scolding others for not learning, הלל himself forgets a הלכה, which teaches humility. His answer is not a ruling but a trust that the people's practice preserves the correct tradition. This sets up the final scene.

keyTerms.meaning: I heard it and forgot it
Leave it to the Jewish people

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר לָהֶן: הֲלָכָה זוֹ שָׁמַעְתִּי וְשָׁכַחְתִּי,
phrases.english: He said to them: This halakha I heard and I forgot,
but leave it to the Jewish people;
if they are not prophets,
they are the sons of prophets.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לָהֶן: הֲלָכָה זוֹ שָׁמַעְתִּי וְשָׁכַחְתִּי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 14 by deferring to the people's practice
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: הלל forgot the law and says to rely on what the Jewish people will do on their own.

steps.title: The people's practice reminds הלל of the הלכה
steps.stepSummary: The next day, people stick the knife in the lamb's wool or between the goat's horns. הלל sees this, remembers, and confirms it is the tradition of שמעיה ואבטליון.
steps.simpleTranslation: The next day, whoever had a lamb as his פסח stuck the knife in its wool, and whoever had a goat stuck it between its horns. הלל saw what they did, remembered the הלכה, and said: This is what I received from שמעיה ואבטליון.
steps.whatsHappening: The question is resolved. The people bring the knife by having the animal carry it, and הלל confirms this is the correct tradition.
steps.deeperAnalysis: No one carries the knife by hand. The animal carries it into the עזרה, which avoids the normal way of carrying on שבת. Since a goat has no wool, its owner places the knife between the horns. הלל's statement turns the people's custom into a confirmed הלכה from his teachers.

keyTerms.meaning: I have received it as a tradition

steps.whatToRemember: הלל proved the פסח overrides שבת (גזירה שוה and קל וחומר) and became נשיא. When he forgot how to bring the knife, the people's practice of having the animal carry it reminded him, and he confirmed it came from שמעיה ואבטליון.
steps.whyThisMatters: This is a classic source for the idea that the practice of the Jewish people (מנהג ישראל) can preserve a correct הלכה.

phrases.english: The next day, one whose Paschal offering was a lamb
stuck it in its wool;
one whose Paschal offering was a goat
stuck it between its horns.
He saw the incident and remembered the halakha,
and said: This is what I received
from the mouths of Shemaya and Avtalyon.

steps.triggerLanguage: לְמָחָר, מִי שֶׁפִּסְחוֹ טָלֶה תּוֹחֲבוֹ בְּצַמְרוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Carries out הלל's deferral from step 15 and resolves the question of step 14
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The knife is brought by attaching it to the animal (in its wool or between its horns), and this is the tradition of שמעיה ואבטליון.

steps.title: Quoting הלל's גזירה שוה of מועדו
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא re-quotes הלל's גזירה שוה: the word מועדו appears by both פסח and תמיד, so just as the תמיד overrides שבת, so does the פסח.
steps.simpleTranslation: The Master said: 'Its appointed time' is said about the פסח, and 'its appointed time' is said about the תמיד. Just as the תמיד overrides שבת, so too the פסח overrides שבת.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is quoting the first proof from the ברייתא so it can examine it. This is a setup line for the question that comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A גזירה שוה links two topics through a shared word. Here the shared word is מועדו. The proof only works if we already know for sure that the תמיד overrides שבת.

keyTerms.meaning: The daily offering brought every morning and afternoon
Overrides שבת (may be offered even on שבת)
A derivation linking two topics through a shared word

phrases.english: The Master said:
'Its appointed time' is stated regarding the Paschal lamb,
and 'its appointed time' is stated regarding the daily offering.
Just as 'its appointed time' stated regarding the daily offering
overrides Shabbat,
so too 'its appointed time' stated regarding the Paschal lamb
overrides Shabbat.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Returns from the story of הלל to analyze the first proof in the ברייתא
steps.mimraCoreRuling: פסח overrides שבת through a גזירה שוה with the תמיד, based on the shared word מועדו

steps.title: How do we know the תמיד overrides שבת?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the source that the תמיד itself overrides שבת.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the תמיד itself – from where do we know that it overrides שבת?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks for the foundation of the comparison. If we learn פסח from תמיד, we first need to know where the rule for תמיד comes from.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A comparison is only as strong as its base case. The גמרא wants to see the actual source for the תמיד before it accepts the comparison.

phrases.english: And the daily offering itself –
from where do we know that it overrides Shabbat?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions the base case of the גזירה שוה
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The scriptural source that the תמיד overrides שבת

steps.title: The word 'its appointed time' cannot be the source
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects the idea that מועדו is the source for the תמיד. The same word appears by פסח, yet פסח still needed a גזירה שוה. So מועדו alone must not teach overriding שבת.
steps.simpleTranslation: If you say it is because 'in its appointed time' is written about it – 'its appointed time' is also written about פסח! So we must say that מועדו does not mean this to him. Here too, by the תמיד, מועדו does not mean this to him.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא suggests an obvious source, the word מועדו, and then knocks it down.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If מועדו by itself taught that an offering overrides שבת, then פסח would not need the גזירה שוה, because it has the word too. The fact that הלל needed the גזירה שוה shows that the word alone does not teach this. The same must then be true for the תמיד.

keyTerms.meaning: If you say (introduces a suggestion that will be rejected)
It does not imply this to him

steps.confusionAlert: The phrase 'אלא מועדו לא משמע ליה' is not the final answer. It is part of the attack, showing that the word מועדו cannot be the source. The real answer comes in the next step.

phrases.english: If you say it is because
'in its appointed time' is written about it –
but 'its appointed time' is also written about the Paschal lamb!
Rather, 'its appointed time' does not imply this to him.
Here too, 'its appointed time' does not imply this to him.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Proposes a source for the question and rejects it
steps.kashyaTarget: The suggestion that מועדו is the source for the תמיד overriding שבת
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: פסח also has מועדו, yet it needed a גזירה שוה. So the word alone cannot teach overriding שבת.

steps.title: The source is the verse about the עולת שבת
steps.stepSummary: The real source is 'עולת שבת בשבתו על עולת התמיד'. This verse shows the תמיד is brought on שבת alongside the מוסף.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, the verse says: 'The burnt offering of שבת on its שבת, besides the תמיד burnt offering.' From this we learn that the תמיד is offered on שבת.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the true source for the תמיד overriding שבת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The verse describes the שבת offering as brought 'in addition to' the תמיד. That only makes sense if the תמיד is also brought on שבת. Now the base case is secure, so the גזירה שוה to פסח can stand.

keyTerms.meaning: The burnt offering of שבת (the מוסף)
By implication, from which we infer

phrases.english: Rather, the verse states:
'The burnt offering of Shabbat on its Shabbat,
besides the continual burnt offering' –
by implication, the daily burnt offering
is offered on Shabbat.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question after rejecting the first suggestion
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The verse 'עולת שבת בשבתו על עולת התמיד' implies the תמיד is offered on שבת
steps.whyThisMatters: It secures the base case. Without it, the גזירה שוה from תמיד to פסח would have nothing to stand on.

steps.title: Quoting הלל's קל וחומר
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes הלל's second proof. If the תמיד, which carries no כרת, overrides שבת, then פסח, which does carry כרת, should surely override שבת.
steps.simpleTranslation: The Master said: And furthermore, a קל וחומר: if the תמיד, whose neglect is not punished with כרת, overrides שבת, then surely the פסח, whose neglect is punished with כרת, should override שבת.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now quotes the second proof from the ברייתא so it can examine it. This sets up the challenge that follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The argument says פסח is 'stricter' than תמיד because skipping it carries כרת. If the more lenient offering overrides שבת, the stricter one should too.

keyTerms.meaning: An a fortiori argument (from lenient to strict)

phrases.english: The Master said:
And furthermore, an a fortiori argument:
If the daily offering, which is not punishable by karet,
overrides Shabbat,
the Paschal lamb, which is punishable by karet –
is it not logical that it overrides Shabbat?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to analyze the second proof in the ברייתא
steps.mimraCoreRuling: פסח, which carries כרת, overrides שבת by קל וחומר from the תמיד

steps.title: The תמיד is frequent and fully burned
steps.stepSummary: The קל וחומר can be refuted. The תמיד has special strengths: it is frequent (תדיר) and entirely burned (כליל). פסח has neither.
steps.simpleTranslation: This can be refuted: what is special about the תמיד is that it is frequent and entirely burned.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks the קל וחומר by showing that the תמיד has advantages the פסח lacks.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A קל וחומר only works if the base case is weaker in every way. The תמיד is stronger in two ways: it comes every day, and it is wholly burned on the מזבח. So its overriding שבת may come from those strengths and not carry over to פסח.

phrases.english: There is room to refute:
what is special about the daily offering
is that it is frequent and entirely burned.

steps.triggerLanguage: אִיכָּא לְמִיפְרַךְ: מָה לְתָמִיד שֶׁכֵּן תָּדִיר וְכָלִיל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the קל וחומר just quoted
steps.kashyaTarget: הלל's קל וחומר from תמיד to פסח
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The תמיד is stricter in other ways (תדיר and כליל), so it is not a weaker base case

steps.title: הלל said the קל וחומר first, then the גזירה שוה
steps.stepSummary: הלל first offered the קל וחומר, the בני בתירא refuted it, and then he gave them the גזירה שוה.
steps.simpleTranslation: He told them the קל וחומר first, and they refuted it. Then he told them the גזירה שוה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains how a refutable proof ended up in the ברייתא. It was said first and refuted, and then הלל moved on to the גזירה שוה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא lists the proofs in a different order than they were actually said. The קל וחומר failed, so הלל relied on the גזירה שוה, which comes from a tradition and cannot be refuted by logic.

phrases.english: He told them the a fortiori argument first,
and they refuted it,
and then he told them the verbal analogy.

steps.triggerLanguage: קַל וָחוֹמֶר אֲמַר לְהוּ בְּרֵישָׁא וּפַרְכוּהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Accepts the refutation and explains the sequence of events
steps.terutzResolutionType: Reordering the sequence of the proofs
steps.terutzHavaAmina: הלל relied on a refutable קל וחומר
steps.terutzMaskana: The קל וחומר was refuted, and הלל then gave the גזירה שוה

steps.title: Why give a קל וחומר if he had a גזירה שוה?
steps.stepSummary: If הלל had a גזירה שוה from his teachers, why did he bother offering a קל וחומר at all?
steps.simpleTranslation: But since he had learned the גזירה שוה, why do I need the קל וחומר?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges why הלל would open with a weaker logical argument when he already had a stronger tradition.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A גזירה שוה from one's teachers settles the matter. Offering a refutable קל וחומר first seems pointless.

phrases.english: But since he learned the verbal analogy,
why do I need the a fortiori argument?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the explanation that הלל said both proofs
steps.kashyaTarget: הלל's choice to offer the קל וחומר
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A גזירה שוה from a tradition is enough. A logical argument adds nothing.

steps.title: הלל was rebuking them for not reasoning it out
steps.stepSummary: הלל said the קל וחומר to rebuke the בני בתירא. They could not derive a גזירה שוה on their own, but a קל וחומר is something anyone may derive, so they should have figured it out.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, he was speaking to them: Granted, you did not learn the גזירה שוה, since a person may not derive a גזירה שוה on his own. But a קל וחומר, which a person may derive on his own, you should have derived!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the קל וחומר was not meant as a proof. It was a rebuke aimed at the בני בתירא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A גזירה שוה needs a tradition from one's teachers, so the בני בתירא can be excused for not knowing it. A קל וחומר is pure logic, though, and they should have worked it out themselves. This fits הלל's earlier scolding about their laziness.

keyTerms.term: אֵין אָדָם דָּן גְּזֵירָה שָׁוָה מֵעַצְמוֹ
keyTerms.meaning: A person may not derive a גזירה שוה on his own

steps.whyThisMatters: It states a basic rule of תורה interpretation: a גזירה שוה requires a received tradition, while a קל וחומר may be derived independently.

phrases.english: Rather, he was saying it to them:
Granted, you did not learn the verbal analogy,

phrases.aramaic: דְּאֵין אָדָם דָּן גְּזֵירָה שָׁוָה מֵעַצְמוֹ.
phrases.english: since a person may not derive a verbal analogy on his own.

phrases.aramaic: אֶלָּא קַל וָחוֹמֶר, דְּאָדָם דָּן מֵעַצְמוֹ,
phrases.english: But an a fortiori argument, which a person may derive on his own,
you should have derived!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers why הלל offered the קל וחומר
steps.terutzResolutionType: Reinterpreting the purpose of the statement (rebuke, not proof)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The קל וחומר was offered as an independent proof
steps.terutzMaskana: It was a rebuke showing that they should have reasoned it out themselves

steps.title: The בני בתירא reply that the קל וחומר is flawed
steps.stepSummary: The בני בתירא answer that they did not use the קל וחומר because it is refutable.
steps.simpleTranslation: They said to him: It is a refutable קל וחומר.
steps.whatsHappening: The בני בתירא defend themselves. They say the קל וחומר was not reliable, so they were right not to depend on it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This connects back to the refutation of תדיר and כליל. Their reply explains why only the גזירה שוה settled the question.
steps.whatToRemember: הלל's real proof that פסח overrides שבת is the גזירה שוה of מועדו. The תמיד's own rule comes from 'עולת שבת בשבתו'. The קל וחומר fails because the תמיד is תדיר and כליל, and הלל mentioned it only as a rebuke.

phrases.english: They said to him:
It is a refutable a fortiori argument.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַרוּ לֵיהּ: קַל וָחוֹמֶר פְּרִיכָא הוּא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: The בני בתירא's reply to הלל's rebuke
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The קל וחומר is refutable, so the law that פסח overrides שבת rests on the גזירה שוה

steps.title: The people hide the knife on the animal
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the ברייתא: the next day, a person whose פסח was a lamb stuck the knife in its wool, and a person whose פסח was a goat stuck it between its horns.
steps.simpleTranslation: The Master said: The next day, someone whose פסח was a lamb stuck the knife in its wool. Someone whose פסח was a goat stuck it between its horns.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes another line from the ברייתא about הלל. It is setting up this line so it can examine it in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: ערב פסח fell on שבת, so people could not carry the knife needed for שחיטה. Instead, they placed the knife on the animal itself (in a lamb's wool, or between a goat's horns), so the animal walked it to the עזרה. This is the practical answer הלל relied on when he said to trust the custom of the Jewish people.
steps.confusionAlert: The person is not carrying the knife. The animal carries it. That is the whole point of the trick: avoiding the איסור of carrying on שבת.
steps.whyThisMatters: This line shows the people's practice that הלל trusted. The גמרא quotes it in order to ask whether this practice itself raises a problem.

phrases.english: The Master said:
phrases.notes: This is how the גמרא quotes a line from the ברייתא so it can talk about it.

phrases.english: The next day, one whose Paschal offering was a lamb
stuck it (the knife) into its wool,
phrases.notes: So the person would not carry the knife on שבת.

phrases.english: a goat — stuck it between its horns.
phrases.notes: A goat has no thick wool, so the horns hold the knife.

steps.alternativePossibleLabel: Setup line for the next קשיא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After finishing the side discussion about the קל וחומר and the גזירה שוה, the גמרא goes back to quote the next line of the ברייתא about what the people did the next day.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: On erev פסח that fell on שבת, people brought the knife by placing it on the animal: in a lamb's wool, or between a goat's horns.
